excerpt: Real, live AI answers about your business, not a simulated score. See what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity actually say — completely free.
content_html:
AI Visibility Score · 100% free

What does AI actually say about your business?

We run 8 real questions a prospective client would actually ask, live against ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity — and show you the verbatim answers.

Not a simulated score. Just your website and a work email; we read the rest off your own site.

Website

Work email

Only used to send you the report — free, no card, ever.

You'll see your business, as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity actually answer it, verbatim. Takes 60-150 seconds — it's running live queries, not a cached answer.

See it in action

We ran this on ourselves. Twice. Here’s what we found.

Why it’s free

The tools that track this charge by the month. We don’t even charge for the snapshot.

Ahrefs’ Brand Radar AI starts at £159/month per platform (£560/month for all five). Semrush’s plans start at $139.95/month. Both are genuinely useful if you’re tracking AI visibility every day.

Most businesses just want to know where they actually stand, right now — so the full check is free, no card, no subscription: see exactly what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity say about you today, then decide if ongoing tracking is worth the optional £6.99/mo.

Mention rate

Checked across 8 real questions, branded and unbranded — not estimated.

Citation rate

The exact sources cited instead of you, by name.

Share of voice

The exact competitors named in your place, by name.

Misinformation check

Whether AI gets basic facts about you wrong — most trackers don’t check this at all.

Frequently Asked Questions

About the AI Visibility Score

What is an AI Visibility Score?

An AI Visibility Score measures how often, and how accurately, AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity mention a business when someone asks a relevant question. It covers three things: mention rate, how often you come up at all; citation rate, which sources the AI cites instead of you; and share of voice, which named competitors get recommended in your place. Kelriva AI's version runs 8 real questions live against all four models and shows the verbatim answers, not an estimated or simulated number. We tested this directly across 15 real UK firms in four unrelated sectors, accountancy, law, fintech, and coaching, and found the same pattern every time: one firm dominated AI mentions per sector while several other established, credible businesses never appeared once. Being real and being good at the work isn't the same as showing up when someone asks an AI which firm to hire. That gap is what this tool exists to show you, with evidence, not a guess.

What does Kelriva's AI Visibility Score actually check?

Four things, each backed by real evidence rather than a single opaque number. Mention rate: how often you're named across 8 branded and unbranded questions a prospective client would realistically type. Citation rate: the exact sources the AI cites instead of you, by name, so you know exactly who's winning that placement. Share of voice: the exact competitors named in your place. And a misinformation check, cross-referencing two models on basic facts like your hours, location, and services, since most visibility trackers don't check this at all and a business can be visible and still be described wrong. The report also checks whether AI crawlers can actually read your site, rewrites one real paragraph from your homepage to show what a stronger version looks like, and ends with a 30-day plan built from the specific gaps found, not a generic checklist.

How is this different from Domain Authority or an SEO ranking?

Domain Authority and search rank measure standing in a list of results a person can scroll through and compare. An AI Visibility Score measures something structurally different: what a generative AI system actually says in a single synthesised answer, which sources it cites instead of you, and whether the facts it states about you are even correct. A page can be fully optimised for search and still be absent from an AI answer, because search engines and AI systems retrieve and synthesise information differently; ranking well is no guarantee of being mentioned at all. That's a separate, and increasingly important, channel: more buyers are starting research with a chat interface instead of a search box, and if the AI doesn't name you there, ranking first on Google isn't what they'll see.

Which AI models does it check?

ChatGPT (OpenAI), Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), and Perplexity, the four AI systems a real buyer is most likely to actually be using when they research a purchase today. Each is queried live, in real time, at the moment you run your check, not pulled from a cache or a pre-recorded sample answer written months ago. That matters because these models update constantly: what one said about your business last month may not be what it says today, especially after a website change, a new competitor's content, or a factual correction elsewhere online. Running the check live is also what lets you use the Recheck button after making a change and see, in the same session, whether it actually moved the needle, instead of waiting on a promised monthly re-scan by email like most competing tools.

How much does it cost?

The full report is completely free, no card, no catch. Just your website and a work email to run it, then the whole evidence report, misinformation check, and prioritised fix list unlocks straight away. Tools that track this continuously charge for it: Ahrefs' Brand Radar AI starts at £159/month per platform, and Semrush's plans start at $139.95/month. We don't charge for the one-off check, because the report itself is the real pitch: if AI models are naming your competitors instead of you, that's worth knowing regardless of what you do next. If you do want ongoing tracking after seeing where you stand, that's a separate, optional £6.99/mo monitoring subscription, cancel anytime, nowhere near what the continuous trackers charge.

What happens after I submit my email?

You see one free result instantly: one real question, one real verbatim answer, so you know straight away whether the tool is legitimate before giving anything else. From there, running the full check against all four models live typically takes 60 to 150 seconds, since it's real live queries, not a cached lookup. Once it's done, you click through to the full report, free, no payment step, no card details anywhere in the flow. We also send the report to the email you gave us, so you've got it even if you close the tab. Monthly monitoring is offered afterwards as an optional add-on you can start or skip, never a requirement to see your results.
